title: CB Confidence moves ES 4 pts on the 1m release candle

hero.caption: That's the average 1-minute release bar range on CB prints for ES. **Max 16 pts** in the biggest ones.

chart.label: Release-bar range, year by year
chart.note: Ranges grew from ~1 pt early to 6-7 pts in 2022-2026.

useIt: I use the 1m range to right-size around CB on ES. Expect ~4 pts avg, up to 16 pts on big prints at 10:00 — don't under-size the release bar. No bias data, just respect the printed volatility.
